name: zhuhai-md
description: Zhuhai Mission Day 2026 map, adapted from the Foshan project.

scripts.build: npm run extract && npm run checklist && npm run plugin
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy public --project-name=zhmd --branch=zhuhai-md
scripts.test: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests && node --test tests/*.test.cjs tests/*.test.mjs
